bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags may not exceed 12 x 6 x 12 inches. One-gallon clear freezer bags and clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches are also permitted.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: Clear bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Lots immediately around the arena are donor-reserved. Public parking is at Truman's Landing, with a free pregame and postgame shuttle from its south entrance.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands operate throughout the arena, with a Club Level stand reserved for Club Level guests. Select stands offer $2.99 hot dogs, popcorn, chips, 16-ounce fountain sodas, and 12-ounce Dasani water.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is reserved for guests with disabilities or mobility needs and their companions. Guest Services near Section 211 provides wheelchair assistance and sensory kits.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests may not re-enter Mizzou Arena after exiting.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Public will call is at the main Mizzou Ticket Office windows on the north side; a valid photo ID is required, and the purchaser must pick up the tickets.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors open 90 minutes before men's basketball for general fans, 105 minutes before for other designated fans, and 60 minutes before women's basketball.
